This clinical description focuses on a 21-year-old Ecuadorian male who underwent evaluation at a genetic clinic after an eight-year interval following his initial misdiagnosis of Noonan syndrome at age 13. Physical examination using Blake criteria fits the diagnosis of CHARGE as depicted in Fig. 2 with criterion including coloboma, ear abnormalities, cranial nerve dysfunction (hypoplasia of the auditory nerve), cardiovascular malformations, hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, growth deficiency and distinctive face. A sequencing panel reported a novel pathogenic variant in the CHD7 gene.
